paragraphs: Use the [support page](/support/) for loader errors, license transfers, and checkout questions. Include your order ID, Windows version, and the exact error text.

Before opening a ticket, check which product and plan appear on your receipt. A delivery question, a loader error, and an account restriction need different information. Include the time the issue started and the exact message you saw. Keep passwords, payment details, and license keys out of public channels.

sections.heading: Choosing a product and keeping order details
paragraphs: Start with the problem you want to understand. The loader page lists the eight advertised gameplay features. The spoofer listing explains a separate hardware utility, while the unban listing describes a workspace for organizing account appeals. Read the individual description before comparing plans. A product name alone does not explain what a purchase includes or how it relates to an existing account restriction.

Our blog and example discussions help explain terms used throughout the catalog. Each article has a publication date and links to related reading. The forum examples illustrate common questions and follow-up answers. For an actual order problem, use the support channel rather than treating an example conversation as a response to your case.

Before checkout, review the selected product, license duration and amount shown by the payment provider. Keep the receipt and order ID so support can identify the purchase. Read the terms for delivery and refund conditions. If you are unsure about Windows compatibility, ask before paying and include the version you use. The status page provides the site’s current loader information, while Activision publishes game requirements and handles enforcement decisions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How cheatsbo7.com handles analytics, cookies, and contact data.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When Google Analytics is enabled, we receive aggregated usage signals such as page paths viewed, session duration, referrer URL, device category, browser family, operating system, and approximate region derived from IP. We do not use analytics to identify individual visitors by name. Checkout and license delivery happen on external checkout pages. We do not store payment card numbers, billing addresses, or wallet tokens on cheatsbo7.com.

If you open a Discord ticket linked from Support, you choose what to share. We typically see your Discord username or display name, the message text, any attachments you upload, and any order ID or license details you paste to speed up troubleshooting.

sections.heading: How we use data
paragraphs: Analytics help us understand which guides and product pages are useful so we can improve content, fix broken links, and prioritize status updates after game patches. Support messages are used only to answer setup, checkout, or license questions. We do not sell visitor lists or Discord handles to third-party marketers.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar storage mainly for analytics measurement when GA is active. These may include session identifiers and campaign parameters so repeat visits are counted correctly without storing passwords or payment data. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings; core pages remain readable without them. Some checkout providers set their own cookies when you leave this site to pay, and those follow the provider’s notices.

sections.heading: Retention and removal
paragraphs: Analytics aggregates are kept according to the analytics provider’s retention window. Discord support threads may be archived after a ticket is closed, but you can ask us to delete identifiable messages you sent if they are no longer needed for an open issue. To request removal, contact us through Support with the Discord account you used and the approximate date of the conversation. We will confirm what we can delete on our side and remind you that payment records may still exist with the external checkout provider.
